facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. The application for a specific program or university follows the respective announcement on the internet. Please refer to the announcement for information on application requirements and application documents.

There are separate application procedures for the European and worldwide programs. The announcement and selection for worldwide programs occur before the selection for European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, you can apply for the European exchange as part of the Erasmus+ program without restrictions.

The announcements and selection for worldwide and European exchange programs occur concurrently. Announcements are published at the end of October, with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
